note: Eastbrook Vale's Realm Builder monument. Source sculpt in tmp/asset_src/realm_builder/ (Tripo base, finished in Blender by scripts/assets/realm_builder_monument.py). Unlike the rest of the Eastbrook civic set this keeps its BAKED ALBEDO rather than town-palette vertex colours, so it does not join the town's merged micro-batch: the carved detail is the point of the statue. Its COLOR_0 is a per-vertex TINT multiplied over that albedo, which is what paints the plaque's dark plate and gold frame.
